name: Ca bong rim
summary: Trà Khúc gobies braised with fish sauce, sugar, pepper, chili, and garlic until dry, brown, and fragrant, then boxed to carry home. The fish turns lightly chewy and salty-sweet, good with rice or as a snack.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the dry braise lightly chewy and salty-sweet. The Cẩm Thành ward article calls it mặn ngọt, salty-sweet.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: after cleaning, braise the fish with fish sauce, sugar, pepper, chili, and garlic until it is dry and evenly seasoned, brown, and fragrant. Eat it with rice or as a snack. The printed pack is a 200 g box.
The Cẩm Thành ward article describes the fish rimmed salty-sweet, cá bống sông Trà rim mặn ngọt.
where: The Trà Khúc, on the Cẩm Thành ward article.
priceBand: 90,000 VND for a 200 g box (Vietnam Airlines).
seoTitle: Ca bong rim — dried river-goby braise
seoDescription: Cá bống sông Trà braised dry with fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and garlic: chewy, salty-sweet, and boxed to carry home. 90,000 VND for 200 g.
